description: Cancel one of the signed-in person's own upcoming bookings by its id from my_bookings (where canCancel is true): the free intro call, or an hour with Ben, whose diamond comes back in their wallet. Name the booking by its label when you ask for their yes. Refused, with a reason, for a booking that is not theirs, already cancelled, or already begun.

bookingId.description: The id of one of the person's own upcoming bookings, exactly as my_bookings lists it.

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, when they gave one. Optional.

name: cancel_booking
